title: Articles: a / an / the — Advanced Use
grammarTitle: Articles — When to Use a, an, and the
grammarNote: Артикли (articles) — одна из самых сложных тем английской грамматики. "A/an" — неопределённый артикль, используется когда существительное вводится впервые или когда говорящий имеет в виду одного из многих. "The" — определённый артикль, используется когда существительное уже известно обоим участникам разговора, когда оно единственное в своём роде, или когда его значение уже сужено.

grammarTable.subject: A / AN
grammarTable.example: "I bought a laptop." (first mention, unspecific — one of many)

grammarTable.subject: THE
grammarTable.example: "The laptop was expensive." (now specific — both know which laptop)

grammarTable.subject: AN = vowel
grammarTable.example: "an hour" (h is silent!) / "an AI system" / "an engineer"

grammarTable.subject: THE = specified
grammarTable.example: "The question we discussed." / "The book you gave me."

rows.example: "I saw a dog. The dog was barking." (2nd mention → the)
"the sun", "the internet", "the president of Kazakhstan", "the moon"
"The book that you recommended." / "The question we discussed." (which one = clear)
"The best student." / "The most important skill." (superlative → always "the")
"She bought a phone." (one phone, not THE specific phone)
"She is a student." / "He is an engineer." (profession = one of many)
"Three times a week." / "Once a day." / "50 tenge a litre."

rows.form: 4. AN before vowel SOUNDS (not just letters)
rows.example: "an hour" (h silent) / "an MBA" / "an AI tool" — sound starts with vowel!

rows.form: "I need a phone." vs "I need the phone."
rows.example: "a phone" = any phone. "the phone" = the specific one we both know about.

rows.form: "She is a teacher." vs "She is the teacher."
rows.example: "a teacher" = profession. "the teacher" = THE teacher (of this class, the specific one).

rows.form: "I saw a film." vs "I saw the film."
rows.example: "a film" = some film, first mention. "the film" = the specific film we discussed.

rows.form: "Turn left at a bank." vs "...the bank."
rows.example: "a bank" = there's a bank, but which one isn't known. "the bank" = the one we both know.
✅ "She is a student at WKU." — profession/role = "a" (one of many students)
✅ "I love music." — zero article for general/abstract concepts. "I love the music at this café." = specific ✅
✅ "Life is difficult." — abstract nouns in general = zero article. NOT "the life".

grammarTip:
Артикли — ключевые правила:

A / AN = «один из многих» (впервые или неконкретно)
"I bought A book." (какая-то книга, одна из многих)

THE = «тот самый» (уже известен, единственный, уточнённый)
"The book you recommended." (мы оба знаем, о какой книге)

A = перед согласным ЗВУКОМ: a book, a university ("юо"!)
AN = перед гласным ЗВУКОМ: an hour ("ауэр"!), an AI, an MBA

✅ После THE — ВСЕГДА: the sun, the internet, the president
✅ Профессии: "She is a doctor." (a = одна из многих)
✅ Второе упоминание: "I saw a dog. The dog was friendly."

ZERO article (без артикля) для:
- абстрактных понятий: life, love, happiness, education
- языков: Kazakh, English
- большинства стран: Kazakhstan, France
- видов транспорта: by car, by train

exercises.text: She is ___ engineer at a tech company.
I bought ___ laptop yesterday. ___ laptop cost a lot.
exercises.hint: First mention: "A laptop." Second mention (known): "THE laptop." ✅

exercises.instruction: Add the correct article or leave blank (zero).
exercises.text: "___ life is short, so enjoy every moment."
exercises.hint: General/abstract concept = zero article. "LIFE is short." NOT "The life." ✅

exercises.text: "She is ___ best student in the class."

exercises.hint: "university" sounds like "yoo-ni-ver-si-ty" → starts with consonant sound "y" → "A university." ✅ NOT "an university"!
"hour" — the "h" is silent → sounds like "aʊər" → vowel sound → "AN hour." ✅
General subject/concept = zero article. "Music is my favourite subject." ✅ NOT "The music."

exercises.text: "She is ___ president of the student council."
exercises.hint: "THE president" = unique position — only ONE president of the student council. ✅

exercises.text: "I once met ___ AI researcher at a conference. ___ researcher was from MIT."
exercises.hint: First mention + vowel sound: "AN AI researcher." Second mention (known): "THE researcher." ✅
Rate/frequency: "three times A week." = per week. ✅
"THE internet" = unique, specific. "EDUCATION" = abstract general concept = zero article. ✅

questions.text: "I saw a dog." — "A" is used because:
opts: First mention — unspecific, one of many
questions.correct: First mention — unspecific, one of many
questions.hint: "a dog" = first introduction; one of many possible dogs. ✅
"an" before vowel sounds. "Engineer" starts with "e" → AN engineer. ✅

opts: The question is specific — both speakers know which one
questions.correct: The question is specific — both speakers know which one
questions.hint: "THE question we discussed" = specified by the relative clause — both know which question. ✅

questions.text: "She is ___ best athlete in the team." (superlative)

questions.hint: "university" = /ˌjuːnɪˈvɜːsɪti/ — starts with "y" sound (consonant). "A university." ✅ NOT "an university".

questions.text: "The sun is a star." — "THE sun" because:
opts: There is only one sun — it's unique
questions.correct: There is only one sun — it's unique
questions.hint: "THE sun" = unique in existence. Only ONE sun. ✅ Unique objects = "the".

opts: Music = abstract general concept, not specific
questions.correct: Music = abstract general concept, not specific
questions.hint: "music" as a general concept = zero article. "I love MUSIC." ✅ "I love the music at this café" = specific ✅.

questions.text: "It was ___ hour before she arrived." (vowel sound)
questions.hint: "hour" — "h" is silent → sounds like "aʊər" → vowel sound → "AN hour." ✅

questions.text: "___ Caspian Sea is the world's largest lake."
questions.hint: "THE Caspian Sea" — seas, oceans, rivers use "THE". ✅

questions.text: "Life is short." — "Life" has no article because:
questions.hint: Abstract concepts used generally (life, love, education, happiness) = zero article. ✅

questions.text: "She is a doctor." vs "She is the doctor." — Difference?
opts: "a doctor" = profession (one of many); "the doctor" = the specific doctor we know
questions.correct: "a doctor" = profession (one of many); "the doctor" = the specific doctor we know
questions.hint: "a doctor" = she works as a doctor (profession). "the doctor" = THE specific doctor of our group/clinic. ✅

questions.text: "She is ___ most intelligent person I know." (superlative)
questions.hint: Superlative = always THE. "THE most intelligent person." ✅

questions.text: "___ internet has changed the world." — Correct article?
questions.hint: "THE internet" = unique, specific thing. There is only one internet. ✅

questions.text: "I met ___ AI specialist. ___ specialist was from WKU."
questions.hint: First mention + vowel sound (AI = "ay"): "AN AI specialist." Second mention: "THE specialist." ✅

questions.text: "___ education is the key to success." (general concept)
questions.hint: "education" as a general concept = zero article. "EDUCATION is the key to success." ✅
